about: Cited points for shield-curves.svg (drawn by shield-curves.js). Every point is a value printed in the named source's table, or (chart 2) the ratio of two values printed in the same source, as noted per series. x = shielding mass in tonnes per square metre (1 t/m2 = 100 g/cm2 = 1 m of liquid water). Read 2026-11-13. Nothing here is invented: where no source table was found (liquid hydrogen, aluminium at these depths) there is no series, and the caption says so.
